league_wrap.title: Camp Desk — Thursday, Sep 3
league_wrap.bottom_line: Named QB2 (Richardson) + Flowers back at practice + Henderson still out + Pacheco IR catch-up. Not a 32-card dump. Existing LAC Under 2/5 and DEN Over 2/5 stand. Everything else Pass.
storylines: Colts: Steichen named Anthony Richardson Sr. the Week 1 QB2 on Thursday, beating Riley Leonard. Jones remains the starter. Pass on a new win-total — this is the backup job, not a starter change.

Ravens: Flowers practiced Thursday for the first time since the Vikings joints (Aug 19–20). Madubuike joined team drills and is day-to-day for Week 1 at IND, per Minter / NFL.com. Upgrade vs a two-week sit. Pass on crowning WR1/DT1 off one practice.

Patriots: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle, since Aug 24) was still off the field Thursday. PFT: if he is still out when official reports start next week, Week 2 is in play. Stevenson and Kiner are the other 53 backs. Pass — do not invent a Week 1 RB1.

Lions: Pacheco (back) IR Tuesday evening never made the Sep 2 file. Misses at least Weeks 1–4 (earliest return Oct 11 vs ARI). Conklin corresponding 53. Gibbs is already the lead back; Campbell is comfortable with Saylors as the spell. Pass on a new number.
league_wrap.what_to_watch: Henderson participation when official Week 1 reports open; Flowers/Madubuike next-week workload before IND; Pacheco IR-return clock. LAC Under 2/5 and DEN Over 2/5 stand — no chase.

team_notes.title: Colts camp — Sep 3
team_notes.bottom_line: Steichen named Richardson the Week 1 QB2 on Thursday. Leonard is QB3. Jones remains the starter. Pass — backup job, not a new win-total.
key_points: Club / Steichen Thursday: Anthony Richardson Sr. is the backup behind Daniel Jones. Riley Leonard opens as QB3. Ends the camp/preseason split of second- and third-team reps.
Richardson requested a trade in February and stayed. Preseason: 21-of-33, 249 yards, 1 INT, plus 68 rush yards and a TD across three games. Do not treat QB2 as a starter change.
Keenan Allen met the media on the DUI case; club says he plays Week 1 and any team discipline stays in-house. Not a number. Pass on inventing a WR sit.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Whether Jones’ Achilles ramp holds into Sep 13 vs BAL — do not mint a Colts number off the backup announcement.
team_notes.sot_flag: Richardson named Week 1 QB2. Jones remains starter. Pass on a new win-total.

key_points: Club / Mink: Flowers was back Thursday after a minor issue that sat him since the Aug 19–20 Vikings joints. Minter had framed it as Week 1 health over camp reps. Wednesday was running drills only.

team_notes.title: Lions camp — Sep 3
team_notes.bottom_line: Pacheco (back) IR Tuesday never made the Sep 2 file. Out at least Weeks 1–4. Conklin corresponding 53. Gibbs already the lead back; Campbell comfortable with Saylors as the spell. Pass.
key_points: Club / CBS / Freep: Lions placed Isiah Pacheco on IR Tuesday, Sep 1 (back). He had an early-August MCL that Campbell said was healed; the back kept him ‘touch and go.’ Earliest return Oct 11 vs ARI (misses NO, BUF, NYJ, CAR).

Corresponding 53: TE Tyler Conklin re-signed. Remaining backs behind Gibbs: Jacob Saylors, Sione Vaki, Jabari Small. Campbell after the Colts preseason game: comfortable with Saylors as the primary spell — ‘a guy in our system.’
This is a catch-up card. Tuesday IR landed after the Sep 1 package and was scanned Wed but not filed. Gibbs was already the bell-cow; IR of the change-of-pace does not mint a Lions number.
team_notes.what_to_watch: Pacheco IR-return window around Week 5 vs ARI — do not write him back before the four-game sit.
